statement: Written before any tuning code was run; no setting below may change after test-case results are seen.
case_rule: single-band designs failing the mask, seed 2026; validation cases only for debugging code
fixed_inputs: negative controls stay at the design's own values

selectors.attribution: |phi| over the 6 geometry features; SHAP/IG/LIME settings exactly as in step 2/3
selectors.random_seed: 2026 + case index (0-based within the 30 test cases)

surrogate_search.objective: V_m(x) + 0.01 * ||(x - x0)/span||^2, V_m = smooth mask violation with all four limits tightened by m dB
surrogate_search.k2: 41x41 grid over the box, best 5 grid points refined by 200 projected Adam steps (lr 0.01, normalized units)
surrogate_search.k6: 512 starts (x0, baseline, 510 uniform random, seed 2026) x 300 projected Adam steps

ads_confirmation.shared_trajectories: identical subspaces share simulations; counts are per method as if independent

ads_coordinate.order: L1, L2, S1, S2, Wc1, Wc2; +step then -step
ads_coordinate.shrink: halve all steps after a full cycle without improvement

ads_true_shap: 64 coalition simulations per case (single reference, same game as step 3), counted separately
metrics: best ADS hard violation on the trajectory
normalized geometry change ||delta/span||_2 of the final design

tests.primary: shap_ref / ig / lime_delta vs random: exact McNemar on success, Wilcoxon signed-rank on best violation, Holm over the three
